PREVENTION OF ACUTE CORONARY SYNDROME
- Life style modifications including regular exercise, optimum weight, high
fibre and low saturated fat diet; cessation of cigarette smoking and
moderate alcohol intake
- Treatment of hypertension, diabetes and hyperlipidaemia
- Others
- Educate on benefits, outcome and complications of patient's condition
and treatment modalities
- Emphasize primary and secondary preventive measures as essential
irrespective of treatment modality offered
